facts.fact: The city describes a park expanded from an original ten-acre plot to thirty acres.
facts.excerpt: has since expanded to cover 30 acres.

facts.fact: The fountain stands at the north end and dates to1858.
facts.excerpt: the iconic 1858 fountain at the north end

facts.fact: The public park has paths, sports courts, monuments and green space.
facts.excerpt: historic monuments, sports courts, walking paths, and open green space.

facts.fact: The city page carries project and restoration updates, including the fountain return notice; it is not a guarantee every facility is open.
facts.excerpt: Forsyth Park Fountain Returns to Savannah
